hardGateFindings.finding: The control state keeps external outcomes not-yet-measured; the five-reader study, hiring-reader solicitation, and outward job-search follow-through are explicitly planned rather than completed. Public portfolio claims preserve collective credit, prototype and archive boundaries, and careful contribution language rather than claiming reader, collaborator, application, interview, or hiring results.

All eight named blind spots have distinct signals, current states, control artifacts, triggers, owners, next tests, decision rules, and evidence-return paths. The checker independently reconciles live inquiry and source counts, exact role and proof classifications, render-derived route inventories and claim budgets, mosaic snapshots, receipt transitions, and current public-surface digests; its current failures are confined to stale prior-run artifacts.

The suite distinguishes deterministic validation, separate read-only LLM judge sessions, and external human evidence. Its provenance contract states that repository receipts are auditable process evidence rather than cryptographic proof, rejects stale bundle-bound judgments, and does not equate LLM role labels or internal scores with human field validation.

Record-level public-safety boundaries are paired with a current combination-level mosaic review covering affiliations, movement, collaborator patterns, private feedback, protected educational records, platform traces, and expedition material. The controls minimize names and route detail, keep private feedback and raw relationship graphs outside the repository, and require renewed review after substantial ingestion and before production.

limitations: This is an independent LLM evaluation of repository controls and public surfaces, not human hiring-reader research, collaborator corroboration, participant review, legal or rights review, or evidence of applications, interviews, or hiring outcomes.

The five-reader study is still planned and is suitable only as a bounded baseline; most entry surfaces receive one reader, so page-specific conclusions require the stated follow-up or additional independent evidence.

The Fair Rent case study is at 53 of 56 claim units and About is at 12 of 12. Their budgets and subtraction rules are observable controls, but quick comprehension and trust remain unmeasured until external readers test the rendered surfaces.

The full checker currently fails because the current-run result and four prior judge artifacts are bound to an older bundle digest. Fresh current-digest judge artifacts and orchestration receipts must replace that stale run state before the suite can record a qualifying round.
Repository digests and session receipts improve auditability but do not cryptographically prove evaluator independence or prevent repository-author alteration.
